evidence.field: File summary; description, source, licensing, file history
evidence.text: The exact Commons search result identifies ACC-s00097.svg as a vector depiction of 三 in Shuowen seal-script style. It lists Sinica Database and other character resources as sources, and specifically points to the s00097 image on 三's Hanziyuan page as the basis. Commons labels the SVG representation public domain and says attribution is appreciated but not required. This is a modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph.

evidence.source: Local workspace SVG; original-file URL verified on the inspected Commons description result
evidence.text: The local SVG contains three separate roughly horizontal strokes. Its pixels were inspected locally; the shape is useful as a seal-style illustration, but does not independently attest an ancient inscription. The direct original image URL is https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/67/ACC-s00097.svg, copied from the exact Commons search result.

search_audit.outcome: Search returned the exact Commons file description with graph/style identity, cited source lead, public-domain declaration, and original image URL. Opening the page directly produced a cache miss; the direct upload.wikimedia.org image URL was inaccessible through the web tool. Local SVG pixels were inspected as a corroborating image check.
Search exposed the Commons category listing the candidate. The exact file page could not be opened; identity, provenance, and reuse terms remain unverified, so it is not proposed.

gaps: No selected image depicts an independently verified Shang oracle-bone or Western Zhou bronze inscription. ACC-s00097.svg is a modern vector drawing in Shuowen seal-script style; it illustrates a later script style, not an excavated artifact or a precisely dated witness.

The local rendering of Shuowen Seal Radical 004.svg was not selected because its exact Commons description page and license could not be inspected. Its category listing alone is insufficient provenance or rights evidence.

items.period: Seal-script style; modern vector redraw, not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 三 in Shuowen seal-script style. Commons identifies the Hanziyuan s00097 image as its basis; this is an illustration of a script style, not an ancient inscription photograph.
items.alt: Three horizontal seal-style strokes representing 三.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons result identifies the graph, style, and source lead, provides a public-domain declaration, and gives the original image URL. The local SVG was inspected and shows three horizontal strokes. It can illustrate a later script style but cannot stand for an excavated early inscription.
items.rights: Public domain, as declared on the Commons file description; attribution is appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: No verified image of the cited Shang oracle-bone examples or the Western Zhou bronze record was selected. The proposed image is a modern seal-style redraw and cannot document those artifact forms.
